title: Persist rename cleaning policy for pipeline naming
summary: Persisted movie rename cleaning filters as backend-owned PSD1 settings and routed pipeline naming, Rename preview/apply planning, the WebView filter editor, and Dashboard current-work naming through that saved policy.
reason: The Settings filename cleaner could use staged browser terms, but the PowerShell pipeline planner still used its older hardcoded cleaner, so saved-looking operator terms such as SupaCvnt, BYNDR, and MA did not affect real output planning.
behavior_before: Rename filter edits were browser-local draft data. The Settings filename test preview could remove custom terms, but normal pipeline naming and Rename apply planning could still keep release-group/service terms because PowerShell did not read those staged lists.
behavior_after: RenameMovieFilterOptions, RenameMovieFilterTerms, and RenameMovieRemoveTerms are persisted settings. Saved policy normalizes categories and terms, powers the PowerShell movie cleaner, is injected into Rename preview/apply requests by the backend, feeds Dashboard current-work movie labels, and remains separately testable as staged policy through the read-only filename preview route.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_local_api.py covers settings preview/save persistence, catalog reload, and saved/staged preview policy use.
tests/python/desktop/test_facade_rename_policy.py covers saved policy normalization and staged/saved clean-preview source labels.
tests/python/desktop/test_service_rename_movie.py covers Iron Lung and Hoppers movie-cleaning examples with saved custom terms.
tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_snapshot.py covers Dashboard current-work labels using saved rename cleaning policy.
tests/python/desktop/test_status_service.py covers Hoppers and Iron Lung current-work labels from raw progress filenames with saved custom terms.
tests/python/desktop/test_webview_browser_rename_smoke.py covers WebView draft recovery, settings patch submission, and staged filename preview labeling.
ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-NamingSupportChecks.ps1 covers New-PlexMovieDestinationPlan output for Iron Lung and Hoppers with saved policy variables.
